changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: create or alter function [dbo].[GetParentObjectId] ( @type varchar(50), @id int ) returns int as begin return ( select S.ObjectID as ParentID from Asset O inner join AssetType OT on OT.ID = O.AssetTypeID inner join [IntersectType] T on T.ObjectAssetTypeID = OT.ID inner join [Predicate] P on P.ID = T.PredicateID and P.[Type] = 3 inner join [Intersect] I on I.ObjectAssetID = O.ID and I.IntersectTypeID = T.ID inner join Asset S on S.ID = I.SubjectAssetID where O.Object = @type and O.ObjectID = @id ) end
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetParentObjectId] ( @type varchar(50), @id int ) RETURNS int AS BEGIN return ( select I.SubjectID as ParentID from Asset A inner join AssetType ST on ST.ID = A.AssetTypeID inner join [IntersectType] T on T.Object = ST.Object and T.ObjectID = ST.ObjectID inner join [Predicate] P on P.ID = T.PredicateID and P.[Type] = 3 inner join [Intersect] I on I.Object = @type and I.ObjectID = @id and I.IntersectTypeID = T.ID where A.Object = @type and A.ObjectID = @id ) END
